items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: That’s when McCain wound up getting shot down

ctx.x: No actually I first took a job for two years as a personnel interviewer, management trainee for Allstate Insurance Company. I worked in two regional offices actually, and I was also like the Affirmative Action officer for the two regions. And I was also a personnel interviewer. So I was a personnel grunt for them and in the management rotational program, which was very interesting, and you know, a Chicago based company. Northbrook, Illinois. Sears & Roebuck, at least at that time they were definitely all totally…

into helicopters. So he became a commander. Because he was a Colonel when he retired. But pop was a chopper commander so when he was transferred at the end of my freshman year, the summer that I went back to Germany between my freshman and sophomore years, he got orders to Vietnam and so he was the first group of the big buildup of choppers that they started to ship over to Vietnam for the war. So we picked up the summer of ’65 and went back to the Peninsula. Of course I was going to school, I had to finish my…

San Francisco and I only lasted there for about two or three weeks because by that time I was already a musician up there and it was so ridiculous because Chet was really trying to just score, trying to get some stuff together. So sometimes we wouldn’t even get paid. So I mean it was just some silly stuff. So I said later for this. But in San Jose, earlier, I did things like that.
